Method of Attack: Ransomware encrypts network and steals unencrypted files for double-extortion
Malware harvests login credentials from banks and financial institutions
Ransomware targeting mostly U.S. government institutions and companies
Discoverer: U.S. Treasury Department's Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC)
Impacted Systems: Hundreds of banks and financial institutions in over 40 countries
More than 234,000 computers starting in 2013, approximately half in the US
Approximately 300,000 computers in at least 150 countries
